newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore IPO share offerings - Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: Singapore IPO share offerings - Oct 28.

text.p: Following is a list of expected initial public share offerings (IPOs) in Singapore.
* Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) approval granted
COMPANY SHRS CURRENCY/ EXPECTED OPEN/ LEAD
(MLN) PRICE LIST DATE
Amara Holdings -- -- -- --
(Amara Holdings Ltd is a hotel company.)

(FJ Benjamin Holdings retails, distributes and licenses
fashion labels, accessories, watches and home fashions. It has said it has received in-principle approval from the SES to list shares on the main board.)
GES Singapore -- S$ 1996 --
(GES Singapore Pte Ltd makes personal computers.)
*Guangzhou Inv 61 HK$2.555 Oct 28 UOB
(Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd is the Hongkong-listed investment arm of the southern Chinese city of Guangzhou. Its primary listing is in Hong Kong.)
*Kian Ann Eng -- S$ Oct --
(Singapore-based Kian Ann Engineering procures and distributes heavy equipment and disel engine spare parts.)
*Lung Kee Metal -- HK$ -- --

(Lung Kee (Bermuda) Holdings Ltd unit Lung Kee Metal Holdings says it has received SES approval in-principle for a primary main board listing. The designer and manufacturer of mould bases plans a combined public offering and private placement.)
*Nobel Group -- S$ 1996 --
(Singapore-based Nobel Group Holdings is in the interior design and furnishings and furniture business, and has received approval for a Sesdaq listing.)
Ossia Int -- S$ -- --
*(Singapore-based footwear, fashion and sporting goods distributor Ossia International will list on the SES main board.)
Raffles Hdgs -- S$ H1 1997 --
(Raffles Holdings is the hotel arm of DBS Land and manages Singapore's Raffles Hotel.)
Sinochem -- -- -- UOB
(Sinochem Asia Holdings is an arm of the Chinese state oil and commodities company Simochem. The company has applied to the SES for a listing.)
